answers.tip: It's the largest city in the state.
answers.feedback: Correct! Honolulu is the capital and largest city of Hawaiʻi, located on the island of Oʻahu.

answers.tip: Hilo is the second-largest, but on a different island.
answers.feedback: Hilo is on the Big Island (Hawaiʻi Island), not the capital.

answers.tip: There are several towns named Kailua across the islands.
answers.feedback: Kailua is a town — there's one on Oʻahu and one on the Big Island, but neither is the capital.

overallFeedback.message: Worth reviewing the islands and their main cities.
